title: M4 Cache strategy: TTLs and targeted invalidation
description:
## Outcome
Readers see an edit within about a minute of Save, without blanket invalidations, and today's staleness sources are removed.

## Design
~/Projects/markus-publication-architecture-v2.md section 2 (Atomicity, versioning, caching).

## Checklist
- [ ] HTML Cache-Control public, max-age=0, s-maxage=86400 set as S3 object metadata; renditions/versioned CSS-JS max-age=31536000, immutable
- [ ] Targeted CreateInvalidation of written paths (both /x/ and /x/index.html forms); measure completion time
- [ ] Fallback switch: s-maxage=60 without invalidation if invalidations prove slow
- [ ] Record and fix today's staleness findings: Pretext s-maxage=3600 plus the Amplify CDN layer; Pilobol.us reader distribution on CachingOptimized (1-day default TTL) with nothing invalidating it
- [ ] Monthly invalidation path count alarm (first 1000 free)

## Acceptance
- After a test edit, curl of the item URL and home through the site hostname shows the new content within 60 s (measured, 5 runs).
- No /* invalidations issued by the projector (CloudTrail check).

## Out of scope
Pretext revalidation redesign beyond documenting/fixing the TTL.

## Dependencies
Blocked by M1.

## Risk
Invalidation latency/cost if edit volume grows.

## Estimate
2-3 agent-hours.

comments.author: home
comments.text: M4 evidence. PRs #195 (48c512a: s3-projection cache policy, batched exact-path invalidation with throttle retry, unpurged retry task, weekly-pace alarm, publication.cache) and #196 (4015baa: Pretext reader revalidate 3600->60 plus expireTime 120, backend.revalidateDistributionIds edge purge). CI green on both. Throwaway CloudFront+S3 (papyrus-production, since deleted): edit-to-visible with targeted invalidation, 5 runs, item and home both new: 1.9-3.1 s from edit start (invalidate call 0.13-0.23 s). 12 edits at 1 s gap: no errors, final content visible within ~9 s. 40 back-to-back invalidations: no throttling. Without invalidation: s-maxage=60 shows the edit after 60.0-61.0 s (4 runs); default s-maxage=300 after 300.3 s. CloudTrail: 63 CreateInvalidation events on the test distribution, 0 with a wildcard. Cost: 2-40 paths/edit; 1000 free paths/month = 250 edits at 4 paths or 50 at 20; beyond that 0.005 USD/path (10 paths x 1000 edits = 45 USD/month). Pretext: local Next 15.5 build shows s-maxage equals revalidate and stale-while-revalidate defaults to about one year (31535940 s) which lets a shared cache serve a page long past s-maxage; expireTime 120 gives s-maxage=60, stale-while-revalidate=60. Amplify CDN layer cannot be purged and a manual-deploy Amplify app does not run SSR compute (served the zip as static), so the layer was not measured live; the bound is s-maxage+swr = about 2 min once a site bumps its pin. App-shell templates byte-identical (sha256) before/after for Pilobol.us x2, p.apyr.us x2, Threat-Intelligence, Pretext example, Anth.us fixture. Pilobol Amplify 301 without cache-control (24 h) is an Amplify default for static apps, not fixed here (M5 moves Pilobol to S3).

right_now_summary: The cache strategy work is waiting for M1, with TTL and targeted invalidation changes still pending.
